welcome_message:
Hello! I am your personnal familiar and will store any reminders you give me. 
 Type /help to see the list of available commands or simply type /newreminder to write down an event you have to be reminded of!
unknown_user: It looks like I don't know you yet... Try typing /start to begin!
ask_reminder: Please tell me what you want to be reminded of!
error_saving: Oops! Something went wrong while saving.
